name: flipkart
title: Flipkart API scraper — India's largest e-commerce marketplace (flipkart.com): product search with full filters, product detail (price/specs/variants/offers), buyer reviews, categories, sellers, similar products, available filters and autocomplete

actions.name: search
actions.description: Flipkart product search with filters — keyword search returning product cards (title/price/mrp/discount/rating/image/url) plus the total result count, paginated. Filter by brand, price range, minimum rating, minimum discount, F-Assured and any category facet (use the `filters` action to discover what a query supports).

params.name: q
params.description: Search keyword.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page (1-based). Page forward with meta.next_page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order.

params.name: brand
params.description: Filter to a brand (exact Flipkart brand name, e.g. Samsung, HP).

params.name: min_price
params.description: Minimum price in ₹ (INR). Applied to the returned cards.

params.name: max_price
params.description: Maximum price in ₹ (INR). Applied to the returned cards.

params.name: min_rating
params.description: Keep only products rated this many stars and up.

params.name: min_discount
params.description: Keep only products with at least this % discount.

params.name: f_assured
params.description: When true, restrict to F-Assured (Flipkart-Assured quality/delivery) listings.

params.name: no_cost_emi
params.description: When true, restrict to products with a No Cost EMI offer.

params.name: include_out_of_stock
params.description: When true, include out-of-stock products in the results.

params.name: facets
params.description: Advanced: raw category-facet filter fragment(s) taken from the `filters` action's `param` field (e.g. 'facets.processor[]=Core i7'). Pass one string or a list to stack several facets.

actions.returns: results[] (title, price, mrp, discount, rating, image, url) + total_results + filters_applied + page + has_more + next_page

actions.name: product

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart product URL.

params.name: itm_id
params.description: Flipkart item id (the itmXXXX in a /p/ URL).

actions.returns: product{title, brand, breadcrumbs[], description, price, mrp, discount_percent, currency, rating, rating_count, review_count, rating_breakup, parameter_ratings, in_stock, seller{}, variants[]{value,price,in_stock,url}, offers[]{type,title,value}, images[], highlights[], specifications[]{name,value}, return_policy, cod_available, no_cost_emi, delivery, similar_products[]}

actions.name: reviews
actions.description: Flipkart buyer reviews for a product, paginated — each review has rating, title, body, reviewer name, location, certified-buyer badge, helpful/up/down votes and date, plus the product's total review count. Page through with meta.next_page to collect them all.

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart product URL.

params.name: slug
params.description: Product slug (the part before /p/; derived from url if omitted).

params.name: itm_id
params.description: Flipkart item id (the itmXXXX in a /p/ URL).

params.name: page
params.description: Result page (1-based). Page forward with meta.next_page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Review ordering.

actions.returns: reviews[]{rating, title, text, author, location, certified_buyer, helpful_count, upvote, downvote, created} + total_review_count + itm_id + page + has_more + next_page

actions.name: category
actions.description: category/browse listing cards from a Flipkart category URL/path — a `/pr?sid=…` category link, a `~cs-…` curated collection, or a store/hub page such as /mobiles or /mobile-phones-store

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart category URL. (category needs url OR path.)

params.name: path
params.description: Site-relative category path (alternative to url).

params.name: page
params.description: Result page (1-based). Page forward with meta.next_page.

actions.returns: results[] listing cards, source, page, has_more, next_page

actions.name: browse
actions.description: Alias of the `category` action — browse/listing cards from a Flipkart category URL or site-relative path. (browse needs url OR path.)

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart category URL (alias of the category action). (browse needs url OR path.)

params.name: path
params.description: Site-relative category path (alternative to url), e.g. /mobiles/pr?sid=tyy,4io.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page (1-based). Page forward with meta.next_page.

actions.returns: results[] listing cards (same as category), source, page, has_more, next_page

actions.name: similar
actions.description: similar/related products from a product page reco widgets

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart product URL.

params.name: itm_id
params.description: Flipkart item id (the itmXXXX in a /p/ URL).

params.name: product_id
params.description: Flipkart product id (FSN) to exclude from results.

actions.returns: results[] related products (title, price, rating, url)

actions.name: seller
actions.description: Who sells a product: seller id, fulfilment and availability, resolved from a product URL — plus storefront catalog cards when a storefront path is supplied. Start with `product_url` (the live-verified route); Flipkart has no public /seller/<id> storefront, so a bare `seller_id` returns metadata only.

params.name: product_url
params.description: Flipkart product URL to resolve the seller from — the recommended locator.

params.name: url
params.description: Generic Flipkart URL (seller storefront or product); treated like product_url when it points at a product.

params.name: seller_id
params.description: Flipkart seller id. Note: Flipkart publishes no /seller/<id> storefront, so this alone yields no catalog — use product_url, or seller_path/seller_url if you already have a storefront link.

params.name: seller_path
params.description: Site-relative seller storefront path.

params.name: seller_url
params.description: Full seller storefront URL.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Product id for seller-of-this-product lookup.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page (1-based). Page forward with meta.next_page.

actions.returns: seller{seller_id, catalog_count, ...}, results[] storefront cards, page, has_more, next_page

actions.name: autocomplete
actions.description: search autosuggest suggestions for a partial query

params.name: q
params.description: Search keyword.

actions.name: categories
actions.description: top-level navigation/category links from homepage state
actions.returns: categories[] {title, url} from the homepage navigation

actions.name: variants
actions.description: Product variants (the sibling SKUs — color/storage/size) each with its OWN price, stock status and product URL, from the product page.

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart product URL.

params.name: itm_id
params.description: Flipkart item id (the itmXXXX in a /p/ URL).

params.name: product_id
params.description: Flipkart product id (FSN).

actions.returns: variants[]{value, product_id, price, currency, in_stock, url}, product_id

actions.name: filters
actions.description: Available search filters (facets) for a query — every filter Flipkart offers for these results: brand, price, rating, discount, offers, availability and category-specific facets (processor, RAM, screen size, etc.), each value carrying a count and a ready-to-use filter `param`. Feed a value's `param` back into search's `facets` argument.

params.name: q
params.description: Search keyword.

params.name: brand
params.description: Optionally scope the facets to a brand first.

actions.returns: filters[]{id, title, values[]{value, count, param, selected}} + total_results + query

actions.name: offers
actions.description: Bank, EMI, exchange and cashback offers for a product (the offer strip on the product page): e.g. 'Flipkart Axis Bank Card 5% cashback', 'Exchange offer up to ₹X off', 'No Cost EMI'. Honest-empty when a product has no active offers.

params.name: url
params.description: Full Flipkart product URL.

params.name: itm_id
params.description: Flipkart item id (the itmXXXX in a /p/ URL).

actions.returns: offers[]{type, title, value} + no_cost_emi + cod_available + product_id
